name: P8 - internal concepts from experience, reused after restart
question: Does a bounded internal representation (concept dictionary + rules over concepts) that ATANOR forms from today's experience log let it predict and act better in unseen situations after a restart, without the log, than keeping the full log or retrieving cases?

experience.source: results/*/explore/experiences_s*.jsonl recorded on 2026-10-24 (22,500 actions: fs 13,500, view 9,000)

raw_observation.fs: a0 exists, a1 is_dir, a2 name-suffix token, a3 content digest (equality only); relation r0(o,p): id(o) is id(p) minus its last segment; no kind / parent_kind / same_content
raw_observation.view: a0..a4 anonymized (object kind, filter, sort, group, value tokens); no relations
raw_observation.inverse: deterministic raw->human state mapping for planning and judging (perception/action interface, not concept learning)

conditions.INTERNAL_B: invented concepts + rules, serialized <= B bytes, test process sees only that file (B = 8 KB primary; 2 KB and 32 KB secondary)
conditions.FULL_RAW: full log, rules over unary + equality raw atoms only (no composed structural atoms, no dictionary)
conditions.CASE: full log, nearest-case retrieval over raw atom sets (majority outcome)
conditions.FIXED: full log, human-fixed concepts (lifted literals kind/ext/parent_kind/same_content, type groups) + learner v4
conditions.FULL_STRUCT: full log, rules over unary + equality + composed structural atoms, no dictionary, no budget (amendment 1.1)

unseen_situations.fs: test-split layouts (new names, extensions, depth-2 targets) in fresh workspaces
unseen_situations.view: test start screens (p3, two open panels, filtered list)
unseen_situations.overlap_check: no unseen situation signature may equal a training-log situation (exact pre-state + action)

measures: prediction accuracy on real executions in unseen situations, stratified by (tool, true outcome) with near-miss failures, >= 20 per cell; fp / fn / effect errors
strict task completion: P1 fs test tasks (20 x seeds 1-3) and view test tasks (20)
representation bytes and number of concepts
reuse: invented concepts used by >= 2 tools or both bodies
revision R1 -> R2: dictionary additions / merges / edits / deletions and accuracy change

USEFUL_CONCEPTS: INTERNAL_8KB fs prediction accuracy >= FULL_RAW + 5 pp AND >= CASE + 5 pp
fs and view task completion each >= FULL_RAW and >= CASE
R1 -> R2 changes the dictionary at least once and prediction accuracy does not drop by more than 2 pp
representation <= B and the test process ran without the log
INVALID: test process accessed the experience log
unseen situations overlap the training log

known_limits: raw attributes and relations are chosen senses (perception)
experience was collected by fixed exploration policies
concepts are bounded to the two bodies' tools
qwen: not used in P8 in any condition

changes: secondary ablation FULL_STRUCT added: full log, rules over all raw atoms (unary, equality, composed structural) without a concept dictionary or budget - separates what the dictionary adds from having the composed atoms
'P1 fs test tasks (20 x seeds 1-3)' operationalized as 60 distinct fs test tasks (indices 0-59), because the experience is fixed and P1 seeds varied exploration logs; view: 20 test tasks

overlap rule operationalized: in the prediction sampler every candidate action whose exact (tool, args, full pre-state) occurs in the training log is excluded before sampling, and the number excluded is reported; task episodes are not filtered (their overlap with training is disclosed, not used for INVALID)
FIXED answers from experience only (documentation fallback disabled) so that no condition gets documentation
INTERNAL primary = R2 (built on E1, revised with E2 only); R1 tested as well for the revision criterion
